T: Are we there yet. Yes. Dinner's ready.
D: Shrek meets Fiona's royal parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away, and it does not go well.
P: Serve the mains when Shrek and King Harold sit down at that awkward family dinner.
S: do you know the Muffin Man
Blueberry muffins: flour, sugar, buttermilk, melted butter and egg mixed briefly, blueberries folded in, crumble on top, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
the tavern full of fairytale villains
Apple wedges dipped in red toffee (sugar, water and red colouring boiled to 150C), set on oiled paper, a little shiny and suspicious.
the cat in boots from Spain

Crisp fried potato cubes with smoky tomato bravas sauce and garlic aioli, alongside sizzling slices of chorizo finished with honey and parsley. Boil 800g potato cubes for 6 minutes, drain, then roast with oil and salt at 220C for 30 minutes until crisp. Simmer 1 tin crushed tomatoes with 1 crushed garlic clove, 2 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of chilli for 15 minutes. Mix 120g mayonnaise with 1 grated garlic clove and lemon. Fry 2 sliced chorizo in a dry pan until crisp, then add 1 tbsp honey. Serve the potatoes with both sauces and the chorizo.
M: the Fairy Godmother's stop at the Friar's Fat Boy drive-thru

Double beef burgers with cheese, bacon, onion rings and a smoky sauce in soft buns, with shoestring fries, the way a fairytale drive-thru would do it. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Fry 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries and 300g frozen onion rings at 220C for 20 minutes. Smash the balls thin on a smoking hot pan, salt and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns and stack 2 patties, bacon, onion rings and sauce in each.
Far Far Away royal roast pork
the awkward dinner with Fiona's parents
Roast pork shoulder with crackling, apple sauce and roast potatoes. Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and roast at 230C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 2 hours.
W: the giant gingerbread man stomping through the kingdom

Butter, brown sugar and golden syrup melted, flour, ginger and cinnamon mixed in, chilled, rolled and cut into one huge gingerbread man and lots of small ones, baked at 180C, iced with gumdrop buttons.
K: the happily ever after potion from her factory
Lemonade with a splash of blue raspberry cordial and a spoon of edible glitter swirled in, poured into little glass bottles.

s.note: do you know the Muffin Man
s.how: Mix 300g flour, 150g sugar and 2 tsp baking powder. Add 250ml buttermilk, 100g melted butter and an egg and stir only until just combined. Fold in 200g blueberries, spoon into a lined muffin tin, scatter with crumble and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

s.note: the tavern full of fairytale villains
s.how: Cut 4 apples into thick wedges and pat dry. Boil 300g sugar, 100ml water, a spoon of golden syrup and red colouring to 150C. Dip each wedge quickly and set on oiled baking paper. Leave to harden for 10 minutes and serve the same day.

m.n: Far Far Away royal roast pork
m.note: the awkward dinner with Fiona's parents
m.how: Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and roast at 230C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 2 hours. Roast 1kg potatoes for the last hour. Serve with 200g apple sauce.

w.note: the giant gingerbread man stomping through the kingdom
w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 120ml golden syrup together. Stir in 375g flour, 2 tsp ginger and a pinch of cinnamon. Chill for an hour, roll out and cut one huge gingerbread man and lots of small ones. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes, then ice with gumdrop buttons.

d.note: the happily ever after potion from her factory
d.how: Pour cold lemonade into small glass bottles or tall glasses. Add a splash of blue raspberry cordial to each and stir gently. Drop in a small pinch of edible glitter and give it one more swirl so it shimmers as it settles. Serve straight away.
